_meta.purpose: The canned demo scenarios. SPEC/04: one UI button per entry, and `make demo-parity` iterates this file per tier. PM-seat owned via CODEOWNERS — a scenario's `question` and `company_profile` assert what the demo asks and who it claims to be asking as, which is product scope, not SME truth and not an engineering probe set.
_meta.why_this_file_exists: Until 2026-08-16 the scenarios lived only as prose in SPEC/00, while SPEC/04 gated over them. pm-spec-reviewer ruled that a criterion whose subject can move without a diff is the trap-census defect class, and that `make demo-parity` must therefore record each scenario's id AND the sha256 of the question and profile it actually ran. "Scenario 1" in a six-month-old artifact means nothing if the question behind it was since reworded.
_meta.count_was_contested: SPEC/00 heads its section 'Demo scenarios (BOTH real, public-domain rules)' and defines TWO. SPEC/04 said '3 canned scenario buttons' and 'the three canned scenarios'. No third existed anywhere in the repo; ui/index.html inherited the 3 from SPEC/04 and nothing else. The parity gate was written to iterate a set whose cardinality two specs disagreed on. Resolved 2026-08-16 at THREE, and the third is DERIVED rather than invented: SPEC/04's UI must render a 'needs human review' state, and neither of the first two scenarios produces one, so that state would have been undemonstrable. A scenario authored to fill a button would be the defect this project keeps finding — SPEC/00's first scenario already carries a correction for a fabricated $10M threshold with 'zero hits across all 485 chunks'.
_meta.company: Nordvale Foods, ~$400M annual sales (SPEC/00). Above every size threshold that appears anywhere in FDA labeling, which is deliberate: applicability in this corpus turns on CONDUCT — whether a label bears the claim — and never on company size (2024-29957#0303, Response 135, per the 2026-08-12 q07 ruling).
_meta.grounding_rule: Every scenario must be answerable from the corpus and its expected behaviour must already be established by a golden question. A scenario is a DEMO of verified behaviour, not a new assertion. The `grounded_in` field names the question that establishes it.

scenarios.label: 'Healthy' claim — did the deadline move?
scenarios.question: The effective date of the new 'healthy' claim rule was delayed. Did the compliance deadline change?
scenarios.demonstrates: The signature trap, and the reason ADR-0006 exists: 2025-03118 delayed the EFFECTIVE date to 2025-04-28 and said in terms that 'the compliance date remains unchanged at this time'. A naive reader moves the deadline; the compliance date is February 25, 2028 and did not move. The recorded agent answer at e26d8ef quotes that sentence back.

scenarios.label: FD&C Red No. 3 — when exactly must we stop?
scenarios.question: We make a strawberry frosting containing FD&C Red No. 3. When exactly must we stop using it, and is product already on shelves illegal after that date?
scenarios.demonstrates: Two dates in one order (food 2027-01-15, ingested drugs 2028-01-18), the existing-inventory safe harbour, and the fact that the order sets NO compliance date so the operative deadline is derived from the effective date (ADR-0006). Behind it sits the administrative stay — lifted 2026-08-05 with both dates CONFIRMED, not moved (ADR-0007) — which SPEC/00 calls the strongest artifact in the corpus.

scenarios.label: Are we affected? — the question that pauses
scenarios.question: Are we affected by the healthy-claim changes?
scenarios.demonstrates: The HITL gate, and it is the ONLY scenario that does. SPEC/04's UI must render a 'needs human review' state; the other two answer `ok`, so without this entry that state has no way to appear in the demo. A question asking whether something applies to the asker, with no product and no claim in it, cannot be answered for that asker at any confidence — there is no asker in it yet. Ends `needs_input`, asks for `company_profile`, and is resumable with the token from the same response.
scenarios.note: The empty company_profile is the point and must not be 'fixed'. q18 is its companion in the golden set: the same question WITH a sufficient profile must NOT pause, because a gate that pauses on everything passes q10 perfectly and is useless.
